name: Classic 909 house
desc: Harvested classic-house 909: four-on-floor kick, offbeat open/closed hats, clap on 3, roll fills every 8 bars, hat filter drifting over 32 cycles. Kept the character of the stage-proven house scene.

code.full: stack(s("bd*4").bank("RolandTR909").shape(.3).gain(${gain}), s("[~ hh]*4").bank("RolandTR909").gain(${hats}).lpf(sine.range(4000,9000).slow(32)), s("~ ~ cp ~").bank("RolandTR909").gain(.5).room(.25), s("~ oh ~ oh").bank("RolandTR909").gain(.4).mask("<1 1 1 0>")).every(${fill}, x=>x.fast(2)).orbit(1).play()
code.peak: stack(s("bd*4").bank("RolandTR909").shape(.35).gain(${gain}), s("hh*8").bank("RolandTR909").gain(saw.range(${hats}*.4, ${hats}).fast(4)).lpf(sine.range(5000,10000).slow(16)), s("~ ~ cp ~").bank("RolandTR909").gain(.55).room(.25), s("[~ oh]*2").bank("RolandTR909").gain(.45), s("rim(3,8,<0 2 4 6>)").bank("RolandTR909").gain(.3)).every(4, x=>x.fast(2)).orbit(1).play()
